title: It is false that: At fan-in two, one NOT gate saves nothing on edges 0-2 1-3 0-4 1-4 2-4 3-4 0-5 1-5 2-5 3-5 0-6 1-6 2-6 3-6 4-6
statement: ¬ (∀ (gates : List PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (o : ℕ), (∀ g ∈ gates, (g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not) ∧ g.inputs.length ≤ 2) → (∀ i j : Fin gates.length, (gates.get i).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not → (gates.get j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not → i = j) → (∀ x : Fin 7 → Bool, PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.eval ⟨gates, o⟩ (List.ofFn x) = decide (∃ i < ([0, 2, 1, 3, 0, 4, 1, 4, 2, 4, 3, 4, 0, 5, 1, 5, 2, 5, 3, 5, 0, 6, 1, 6, 2, 6, 3, 6, 4, 6] : List ℕ).length / 2, (List.ofFn x).getD (([0, 2, 1, 3, 0, 4, 1, 4, 2, 4, 3, 4, 0, 5, 1, 5, 2, 5, 3, 5, 0, 6, 1, 6, 2, 6, 3, 6, 4, 6] : List ℕ).getD (2 * i) 0) false = true ∧ (List.ofFn x).getD (([0, 2, 1, 3, 0, 4, 1, 4, 2, 4, 3, 4, 0, 5, 1, 5, 2, 5, 3, 5, 0, 6, 1, 6, 2, 6, 3, 6, 4, 6] : List ℕ).getD (2 * i + 1) 0) false = true)) → ∃ (gates' : List PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (o' : ℕ), (∀ g ∈ gates', (g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or) ∧ g.inputs.length ≤ 2) ∧ gates'.length ≤ gates.length ∧ ∀ x : Fin 7 → Bool, PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.eval ⟨gates', o'⟩ (List.ofFn x) = decide (∃ i < ([0, 2, 1, 3, 0, 4, 1, 4, 2, 4, 3, 4, 0, 5, 1, 5, 2, 5, 3, 5, 0, 6, 1, 6, 2, 6, 3, 6, 4, 6] : List ℕ).length / 2, (List.ofFn x).getD (([0, 2, 1, 3, 0, 4, 1, 4, 2, 4, 3, 4, 0, 5, 1, 5, 2, 5, 3, 5, 0, 6, 1, 6, 2, 6, 3, 6, 4, 6] : List ℕ).getD (2 * i) 0) false = true ∧ (List.ofFn x).getD (([0, 2, 1, 3, 0, 4, 1, 4, 2, 4, 3, 4, 0, 5, 1, 5, 2, 5, 3, 5, 0, 6, 1, 6, 2, 6, 3, 6, 4, 6] : List ℕ).getD (2 * i + 1) 0) false = true))
unlocks: Direction 4 (one NOT gate): the smallest graphs on which one NOT gate saves a gate, if any
sketch: A proof is one explicit counterexample to the positive statement L-meta-10486; none is expected if that statement is true.
